messages:
Avery: Heads-up 1: were consolidating the Northbridge QBR deck. Need slide owners, a short renewal risk paragraph, and a crisp exec ask. Can we do a quick assignment here?

Noah: Ill take onboarding status + rollout metrics. Ill include a 3-bullet risk summary and one-liner ask for infra quotas.

Rina: happy to take the renewal risks & proposed mitigation table. Planning to call out SSO, retention policy, and two minor UX items. Will surface owners for each mitigation.

Diego: Ill compile the action tracker and current enablement gaps. prefer to keep detailed timeline in the runbook and show just top 3 asks in the deck.

Olivia: I have a short customer testimonial and usage chart we can use for the openslide. dropping both into the shared deck.

Avery: shared runbook: https://redwood.app/s/nb-qbr-runbook-v4 (please add pointers to appendix). Dry run Tue 3pm PT, exec meeting Wed 11am PT. Final deck due Tue noon PT.

deck-bot: Template v2 synced at 1746006600 to /decks/templates/qbr-2025-v2.

Noah: quick note on onboarding: 4 customers in pilot, 2 are in "waiting for capacity" due to quota & region enablement. Proposed exec ask: "Expedite region quota approvals for Northbridge pilots (48-72h)". Adding to slide.

Rina: renewal risk paragraph draft:
"Northbridge sits at 68/100 health. Primary renewal risks: SSO integration delays (blocking user sign-on), data retention ambiguity impacting compliance, and quota limits slowing pilot expansion. With targeted exec assistance on quotas + prioritizing SSO fixes, renewal likelihood improves materially. Proposed exec asks below."

Diego: action items (short):
- Diego: action tracker slide + appendix pointer (Tue 11:45am)
- Rina: mitigation table + owner assignments (Mon EOD)
- Noah: onboarding slide + quota ask wording (Tue 11am)
- Olivia: testimonial & usage chart (pushed)
- Avery: update CRM stage & coordinate dry run (Tue)

Olivia: pulled the NPS blurb and added a 1-sentence customer quote to the openslide. format looks good.

Avery: CRM note 1: I'll update SFDC to "Needs Exec Assist" after Rina confirms mitigation wording. Also will ping Sales Ops to prep the quota request.

Noah: small FYI for eng: onboarding slide will include a short snippet of the infra error weve seen: "region quota error: insufficient ips"  can someone confirm exact error text?

Diego: will reach out to infra and paste the exact log here by EOD.

Rina: doing a final pass on mitigation language tonight; will paste in thread for review before I commit to deck.

Avery: timeline reminder: Tue noon final deck -> Tue 3pm dry run -> Wed 11am exec. If anyone misses the noon deadline I will reassign slides to cover.

Noah: aiming to have my slide in by Tue 10:30 to allow review.

Rina: same  will post mitigation table by Mon 5pm.

Diego: action tracker uploaded. added owners and due dates, linking appendix slide 14.

Olivia: pushed visuals to the deck. small tweak: can we shorten the testimonial to one line for the exec slide?

Avery: yes, keep a 1-line pull quote on the main deck and full quote in appendix.

Noah: request: can CS Ops update renewal stage to "At Risk - exec assist" once mitigation language is final? want Sales to get notified.

Avery: will do that after Rina's final copy.

Rina: pasted mitigation copy here for quick review:
"Mitigations: 1) Prioritize SSO workstream with Product (owner: Product Eng)  ask: dedicated engineering hours for 2 sprints; 2) Publish clear retention SLA with legal and customers (owner: CS/Product); 3) Fast-track region quotas by Sales Ops/Infra (owner: Infra). Exec ask: approval to allocate quota + 2 sprints of eng bandwidth to SSO.

"

Noah: looks good  small wording tweak: change "2 sprints" to "~3 weeks" for exec clarity.

Rina: updated.

Avery: great, I'll update SFDC and book the dry run. Thanks everyone.

(3 reactions on Avery's last message: :white_check_mark: :rocket: :eyes:)
